Ajay S Bhavsar 
 

Mail ID: ajaysbhavsar@gmail.com 

Contact No: +91 7874707085 

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ajaybhavsar 

  

 

Summary 

Experienced Document Control Coordinator and Mechanical Engineer with a background in power plant 
operations and managing project documentation in Oil & Gas and Energy projects from Pre-FEED to Handover. 
Proficient in EDMS tools like Aconex, SharePoint, SAP, and other EDMS platforms. Hands-on experience in 
combined-cycle power plant operations has developed sharp analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a strong 
grasp of complex engineering systems—enhancing understanding of technical documents and coordination 
across EPC teams. Known for ensuring compliance with CFIHOS and IM standards, streamlining document 
workflows, and onboarding project teams effectively to ensure documentation integrity and project success. 
 

Skills Summary 
 

• Technical Skills:  

• EDMS Platforms: Aconex, SharePoint, SAP, Web BFS, DocuSign, Power BI, AutoCAD 

• Microsoft Office: Word, PowerPoint, Excel 

• Document Control & Compliance: CFIHOS, IM Standards, Engineering & Procurement 
Coordination, Engineering documentation standards (Oil & Gas) 

• Soft Skills: 

• Communication & Team Collaboration 

• Problem-Solving & Decision-Making 

• Leadership & Training 

• Project Management & Coordination 

• Project Monitoring & Stakeholders management 

Work Experience 

L&T Technology Services Ltd.                                                                          Feb 2023 - Present 

Document Controller (Project Control Specialist) | Engineer | Vadodara 

• Supported engineering teams and Project Engineering Managers (PEM) in managing documentation 
across all project phases (Pre-FEED to Handover), ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and timely 
execution. 

• Managed internal document workflows, version control, and approvals using Aconex and SharePoint, 
facilitating the structured release of engineering deliverables in line with project requirements. 

• Maintained and updated Master Document List (MDL) and Document Distribution Matrix (DDM), 
tracking incoming and outgoing transmittals to clients and vendors. 

• Collaborated with engineers and PEMs to track and compile Customer Reply Sheets, following up on 
outstanding actions and ensuring timely closures. 

• Supported the compilation and validation of design freeze documents and certifications by gathering 
confirmations from internal teams and project partners. 

• Assisted in generating document numbers, creating structured project folders aligned with PTS 
(Project Technical Specifications), and ensuring correct document placement. 

• Generated metadata-driven reports such as PTS Reports, overdue trackers, and MDR updates, 
enabling project managers to track document status and deliverables. 

• Monitored and coordinated responses to customer comments, ensuring timely closure and proper 
documentation of replies from internal teams and partners. 

mailto:ajaysbhavsar@gmail.com
https://ind01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fajay-b-487763216&data=05%7C02%7CAjay.bhavsar%40ltts.com%7C1a33dadc4daa47696b2a08dd99bf6f09%7C311b33788e8a4b5ea33fe80a3d8ba60a%7C0%7C0%7C638835769668437160%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=tslnd8Uin1gWH8hUH0VtnEp9rvKcTc%2FcHjBoxkcevmo%3D&reserved=0


• Contributed to the creation and maintenance of PTS folders for project partners, ensuring 
synchronization between internal and external documentation. 

• Controlled and followed up on project correspondence and communications using Aconex, 
SharePoint (EDMS Tools) , supporting both internal coordination and external communication 
protocols. 

• Assisted in collecting, verifying, and compiling As-Built documentation packages for final submission, 
ensuring alignment with project closure requirements. 

• Authored and implemented Information Management procedures based on CFIHOS and industry 
standards, promoting consistency and compliance. 

• Led document on boarding and compliance guidance for EPC contractors and vendors, ensuring 
adherence to metadata standards and document workflows. 

• Managed bid activities within the Aconex Tender Module, including tender document uploads, vendor 
tracking, query resolution, report generation, and support during the evaluation process to streamline 
procurement operations. 

• Trained and supported new team members by providing operational guidance, on boarding 
assistance, and best practices in documentation strategy, enhancing team efficiency and accuracy. 

Torrent Power Ltd.                                                                                       Sep 2020 – Feb 2023 

Shift Operation Engineer | Surat & Dahej 

❖ Documentation & Compliance 

• Managed technical documentation using SAP and BFS software, ensuring accurate tracking, compliance 
reporting, and streamlined data management for plant operations. 

• Compiled & reviewed log sheets, maintaining accuracy in monthly reports, maintenance records, and 
legal compliance filings for audits. 

• Oversaw documentation workflows for startup/shutdown procedures, preventive maintenance records, 
and shift-wise operational logs to ensure traceability. 

• Tracked gas and hydrogen system operations, recording PRV skids, heaters, emergency stop valves, 
and compressor processes for compliance. 

• Maintained equipment testing logs for Black Start Diesel Generators, Emergency Diesel Generators, and 
fire-fighting systems, ensuring adherence to safety protocols. 

• Led emergency response documentation, recording deluge valve tests, detector verifications, and 
emergency drive assessments for audits. 

• Supported site progress, quality, and safety monitoring by preparing inspection checklists, SOPs, and 
project closure documentation as per requirements. 

❖ Technical Operations 

• Operated & monitored a 1,530 MW combined-cycle power plant with single-shaft configuration, ensuring 
smooth operations via Siemens T3000 DCS. 

• Led real-time monitoring of Gas Turbines (Siemens SGT5-4000F), Generators, Steam Turbines, and 
HRSG, optimizing efficiency. 

• Executed routine trials for Boiler Feed Pumps, Condensate Pumps, Circulating Water Pumps, ensuring 
reliability. 

• Managed plant startup & shutdown activities, overseeing critical parameters for turbines, generators, and 
HRSG. 

• Handled switchyard operations, managing 400KV GIS, 400KV AIS & 220KV AIS transmission systems 
for grid stability. 

• Performed routine checks on water treatment plants, DM systems, HVAC, and raw water processing to 
ensure operational integrity. 

• Implemented preservation measures for HRSG, Gas Turbines, and Steam Turbines to maintain asset 
longevity. 

• Supervised switchgear operations, managing HV (6.6 KV), MV (415 V), and UPS switchgear, ensuring 

efficient power distribution. 

 

Internship & Academic Project 



• Reliance Industries Ltd                                                                                                Jun 2019 – Jul 2019 

Mechanical Engineer Intern | Surat 
- Observed mechanical systems in petrochemical and air separation units, gaining hands-on exposure to          
industrial equipment operations, safety protocols, and maintenance practices in oil & gas processing. 

• Project: Bladeless Wind Turbine 
- Designed a bladeless turbine based on vortex shedding to convert wind energy into electricity.     
Focused on low-maintenance, safe, and cost-effective energy generation for urban applications. 

 

Education 

• L.D. College of Engineering | Ahmedabad | Jun 2020 
Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) – Mechanical Engineering | CGPA: 8.34 

• I.N. Tekrawala High School | Surat | Mar 2016 
Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) | Percentage: 87% 

• I.N. Tekrawala High School | Surat | Mar 2014 
Secondary School Certificate (SSC) Mar 2014 | Percentage: 89% 

 

Achievements & Extracurricular Activities 

• Received SPOT Award for successfully managing and completing bid activity, ensuring a smooth 
procurement process and seamless vendor coordination. 

• Earned client appreciation for the successful completion of the Pre-FEED stage of an oil & gas EPC 
project, meeting strict compliance and quality benchmarks. 

• Led corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives, supporting underprivileged and malnourished 
children in villages near Dahej, Gujarat, promoting education and healthcare efforts. 

• Engaged in community service programs, providing aid and support in slum areas of Surat, Gujarat, 
advocating for social welfare and sustainable development. 
 

About Me 

• Marital Status: Unmarried 

• Birthdate: 08/10/1998 

• Languages Known: English, Gujarati, Hindi, Marathi
